about.description:
OCaml is an implementation of the ML language, based on the Caml Light
dialect extended with a complete class-based object system and a powerful
module system in the style of Standard ML.

OCaml comprises two compilers. One generates bytecode which is then
interpreted by a C program. This compiler runs quickly, generates compact
code with moderate memory requirements, and is portable to essentially any
32 or 64 bit Unix platform. Performance of generated programs is quite good
for a bytecoded implementation.  This compiler can be used either as a
standalone, batch-oriented compiler that produces standalone programs, or as
an interactive, toplevel-based system.

The other compiler generates high-performance native code for a number of
processors. Compilation takes longer and generates bigger code, but the
generated programs deliver excellent performance, while retaining the
moderate memory requirements of the bytecode compiler.
about.summary: Objective Caml (OCaml) is an implementation of the ML language.

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  build_number: 17
  version: 5.4.0
  flexdll_version: "0.44"

  dot: ${{ "./" if unix else "" }}
  library: ${{ "Library/" if not unix else "" }}
  m2: ${{ "m2-" if not unix else "" }}
  sh: ${{ "sh" if unix else "bat" }}
  so: ${{ "so" if unix else "dll" }}
  xt: ${{ "" if unix else ".exe" }}
  # Indirection so the autotick bot's compiler-stub regex only rewrites this line
  cc: ${{ c_compiler }}
  # True on the win-64 vs2022 track
  is_vs2022: ${{ not unix and c_compiler == "vs2022" }}

  # ===========================================================================
  # GCC-style derived values (not variant keys - keeps filenames clean)
  # cross_target_platform_ comes from variants.yaml
  # ===========================================================================
  # Derive triplet from cross_target_platform_
  target_triplet: >-
    ${{
      "x86_64-conda-linux-gnu"      if cross_target_platform_ == "linux-64"                          else
      "aarch64-conda-linux-gnu"     if cross_target_platform_ == "linux-aarch64"                     else
      "powerpc64le-conda-linux-gnu" if cross_target_platform_ == "linux-ppc64le"                     else
      "riscv64-conda-linux-gnu"     if cross_target_platform_ == "linux-riscv64"                     else
      "s390x-conda-linux-gnu"       if cross_target_platform_ == "linux-s390x"                       else
      "x86_64-apple-darwin13.4.0"   if cross_target_platform_ == "osx-64"                            else
      "arm64-apple-darwin20.0.0"    if cross_target_platform_ == "osx-arm64"                         else
      "x86_64-w64-mingw32"          if cross_target_platform_ == "win-64" and cc == "gcc"    else
      "x86_64-pc-windows"           if cross_target_platform_ == "win-64" and cc == "vs2022" else
      "aarch64-w64-mingw32"         if cross_target_platform_ == "win-arm64" and cc == "zig" else
      "unknown"
    }}
  # Which platform builds cross-compilers for each target. Empty for a target
  # that is not listed, which never equals target_platform, so an unlisted
  # target builds nowhere.
  cross_build_platform: >-
    ${{
      "linux-aarch64" if cross_target_platform_ in ["linux-ppc64le", "linux-riscv64", "linux-s390x"] else
      "linux-64"      if cross_target_platform_ in ["linux-aarch64"]                                 else
      "osx-arm64"     if cross_target_platform_ == "osx-64"                                          else
      "osx-64"        if cross_target_platform_ == "osx-arm64"                                       else
      "win-64"        if cross_target_platform_ == "win-64"                                          else
      ""
    }}
  # Second build machine for the targets whose cross-compiler is published for
  # two of them, empty for the rest. A folded block renders to a string, so the
  # two-host test lives in is_cross_compiler, where the expression is inline and
  # keeps its boolean type.
  cross_build_platform_alt: >-
    ${{ "linux-64" if cross_target_platform_ in ["linux-ppc64le", "linux-riscv64", "linux-s390x"] else "" }}

  cross_stdlib_version: ${{ "2.39" if cross_target_platform_ == "linux-riscv64" else c_stdlib_version | default("2.17") }}
  cross_c_compiler_version: ${{ "14" if cross_target_platform_ == "linux-s390x" else c_compiler_version | default("") }}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Build case detection helpers (exactly one is true per build)
  # ===========================================================================
  is_native: ${{ cross_target_platform_ == target_platform and build_platform == target_platform }}
  is_cross_compiler: ${{ cross_target_platform_ != target_platform and (cross_build_platform == target_platform or cross_build_platform_alt == target_platform) }}
  is_cross_target: ${{ cross_target_platform_ == target_platform and build_platform != target_platform }}
  is_standard_layout: ${{ is_native or is_cross_target }}
  # OCaml 5.4 has no native-code backend for arm64 Windows, so that target is
  # bytecode-only whatever the toolchain: no ocamlopt, no .opt drivers and no
  # native runtime or nat libraries.
  has_native_backend: ${{ cross_target_platform_ != "win-arm64" }}
  # ocamldoc is configured out on win-arm64: its man-page rule deadlocks under
  # the arm64 runtime.
  has_ocamldoc: ${{ cross_target_platform_ != "win-arm64" }}
  # Mode string handed to the test scripts so they skip native-only probes.
  native_mode: ${{ "native" if has_native_backend else "bytecode" }}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Targets whose cross-compiler is built in this lane instead of coming from a
  # published ocaml_<target> package. One condition drives both the
  # is_cross_target build requirement and the build.sh cross-target branch, so
  # the two cannot disagree.
  # MAINTAINED LIST: prune a target once its cross-compiler is published on
  # conda-forge FOR THIS LANE'S BUILD PLATFORM. Nothing self-corrects, so a
  # stale entry means that lane keeps building its own cross-compiler forever
  # with no signal that it is doing so. linux-ppc64le and linux-riscv64 stay
  # listed because no ocaml_linux-ppc64le or ocaml_linux-riscv64 is published for
  # their linux-aarch64 build platform yet.
  # linux-s390x stays listed because its
  # gcc 14 toolchain cannot share an environment with the gcc 15 build-platform
  # ocaml its published cross-compiler requires.
  # ===========================================================================
  bootstrap_in_lane: ${{ is_cross_target and cross_target_platform_ in ["linux-ppc64le", "linux-riscv64", "linux-s390x"] }}

  # ===========================================================================
  # zstd (marshal compression) support. Off only for linux-s390x, which has no
  # zstd conda package. Drives OCAML_HAS_ZSTD (build.sh) and gates the zstd
  # requirement below, so both agree with the single flag here.
  # ===========================================================================
  has_zstd: ${{ cross_target_platform_ not in ["linux-s390x"] }}

  # ===========================================================================
  # QEMU emulation for cross-target execution tests (linux targets only)
  # ===========================================================================
  qemu_arch: ${{ cross_target_platform_ | replace("linux-64", "x86_64") | replace("linux-", "") }}
  is_qemuable: ${{ (is_cross_compiler or is_cross_target) and (cross_target_platform_ in ["linux-64", "linux-aarch64", "linux-ppc64le", "linux-riscv64", "linux-s390x"]) and (cross_target_platform_ != build_platform) }}
  qemu_pkg: ${{ ('qemu-execve-' ~ qemu_arch ~ '[version=">=11", build_number=">=12"]') if is_qemuable else '' }}

recipe:
  name: ocaml-packages
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 4ab55ac30d247e20f35df20a9f7596e5eb5f92fbbd0f8e3e54838bbc3edf931e
    patches:
      # Fix header include order bug where atomic_load_acquire/atomic_store_release
      # macros are undefined when mlvalues.h is included before platform.h.
      # The macros were guarded by CAML_INTERNALS, but public headers include
      # camlatomic.h, setting the include guard before CAML_INTERNALS is defined.
      - patches/fix-camlatomic-include-order.patch
      # s390x native codegen needs indirect PLT stubs routed through the GOT.
      - patches/s390x-got-indirect-plt.patch
      # Request marshal compression only when the runtime supports it (no zstd
      # on linux-s390x), so output_value never asks an unsupported runtime.
      - patches/compression-only-when-supported.patch
      # Only apply on Unix - Windows uses flexlink which shouldn't be overridden
      - if: unix
        then: patches/0002-ocamlmklib-conda-env-vars.patch
      # Teaches configure to accept the aarch64-w64-mingw32 triple and select
      # the mingw64arm flexdll chain.
      - if: cross_target_platform_ == "win-arm64"
        then: patches/add-aarch64-w64-mingw32-support.patch
      # clang defines __GNUC__ but its __builtin_setjmp is unusable on Windows,
      # so the MPR#7638 GCC branch has to exclude it.
      - if: not unix
        then: patches/fix-clang-mingw64-setjmp.patch
  - if: not unix
    then:
      - url: https://github.com/ocaml/flexdll/archive/refs/tags/${{ flexdll_version }}.tar.gz
        sha256: b7c6a92286f1f3065324d51083dcb16eec436a4e6e3b8df7cf836b6d7a8b9491
        target_directory: flexdll
        patches:
          # Adds the mingw64arm chain and build target to flexdll.
          - if: cross_target_platform_ == "win-arm64"
            then: patches/flexdll-add-mingw64arm-support.patch
          # Modern windres rejects the FLEXDLL_FULL_VERSION macro expansion in
          # version.rc VALUE entries.
          - patches/flexdll-version-rc-windres-syntax-fix.patch
          # OCaml's root Makefile expects .obj aliases for the mingw64 chain;
          # flexdll only produces .o. Its context lines come from the mingw64arm
          # patch above, so it carries the same selector.
          - if: cross_target_platform_ == "win-arm64"
            then: patches/flexdll-makefile-obj-extension-for-mingw64.patch
          # Guards flexdll's parse-time ocamlopt -version / -where shell probes
          # so they can be supplied via env.
          - patches/flexdll-makefile-skip-ocamlopt-probes.patch
          # flexlink emits ARM64 section relocs in descending order, which
          # lld-link turns into a stray out-of-order .reloc block.
          - if: cross_target_platform_ == "win-arm64"
            then: patches/flexdll-arm64-sort-coff-relocs.patch
  - if: not unix and c_compiler == "vs2022"
    then:
      url: https://github.com/ocaml/winpthreads/archive/d635af4d9bcce7f268b3e3c44f414611bbc66381.tar.gz
      sha256: f390e421dfbc3e5182cbe98832f23c946863349719db9a5439d578875a262193
      target_directory: winpthreads

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  # ==========================================================================
  # METAPACKAGE: ocaml
  # Depends on the platform-specific implementation ocaml_${{ cross_target_platform_ }}
  # Only built when cross_target_platform_ == target_platform (alongside native compiler)
  # ==========================================================================
  - package:
      name: ocaml
    build:
      string: ${{ cc ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      skip: cross_target_platform_ != target_platform
      noarch: generic
      script: echo "OCaml metapackage"
      # Down-prioritize the vs2022 track so the solver prefers gcc on win-64
      variant:
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if is_vs2022 else 0 }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("ocaml_" ~ cross_target_platform_, exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("ocaml", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
      - script:
          - if: build_platform == target_platform
            then: ocaml -version
            else: echo "Skip on cross-compiled platform"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PLATFORM IMPLEMENTATION: ocaml_${{ cross_target_platform_ }}
  #
  # Three mutually exclusive build cases (exactly one applies per build):
  #
  # 1. NATIVE (is_native): cross_target_platform_ == target_platform == build_platform
  #    Native compiler built on its own platform (e.g., linux-64 on linux-64)
  #
  # 2. CROSS-COMPILER (is_cross_compiler): cross_target_platform_ != target_platform AND this lane is one of its build machines
  #    Cross-compiler built on designated platform (e.g., aarch64 cross on linux-64)
  #    Produces binaries that run on build platform, generate code for cross_target_platform_
  #
  # 3. CROSS-TARGET (is_cross_target): cross_target_platform_ == target_platform AND build != target
  #    Native compiler built via cross-compilation (e.g., aarch64 native built on linux-64)
  #    Produces native binaries for target platform
  # ==========================================================================
  - package:
      name: ocaml_${{ cross_target_platform_ }}
    build:
      string: ${{ cc ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script:
        file: build.sh
        env:
          OCAML_TARGET_PLATFORM: "${{ cross_target_platform_ }}"
          OCAML_TARGET_TRIPLET: "${{ target_triplet }}"
          OCAML_BOOTSTRAP_IN_LANE: "${{ 1 if bootstrap_in_lane else 0 }}"
          OCAML_HAS_ZSTD: "${{ 1 if has_zstd else 0 }}"
          # Executes some target binaries on the build machine (e.g. tools/ocamlobjinfo.opt)
          # under qemu-user. Empty on lanes where is_qemuable is false, so inert there.
          OCAML_QEMU: "${{ ('qemu-execve-' ~ qemu_arch) if is_qemuable else '' }}"
      skip: not (is_native or is_cross_compiler or is_cross_target)
      # Down-prioritize the vs2022 track so the solver prefers gcc on win-64
      variant:
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if is_vs2022 else 0 }}
      dynamic_linking:
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          - if: is_cross_compiler and aarch64
            then:
              - ld-linux-aarch64.${{ so }}.1
          - if: is_cross_compiler and ppc64le
            then:
              - ld64.${{ so }}.2
          - if: osx
            then:
              - /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib
          - if: not unix
            then:
              - C:/Windows/system32/SHLWAPI.dll
              - C:/Windows/system32/VERSION.dll
      prefix_detection:
        force_file_type:
          text:
            # --- NATIVE/CROSS-TARGET: Standard lib paths ---
            - if: is_standard_layout
              then:
                - lib/ocaml/ld.conf
                - lib/ocaml/Makefile.config
                # runtime-launch-info contains a text header with BINDIR path that
                # must be relocated so bytecode shebangs resolve ocamlrun correctly
                - lib/ocaml/runtime-launch-info

            # --- CROSS-COMPILER: Cross-compiler lib paths ---
            - if: is_cross_compiler
              then:
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/*/lib/ocaml/ld.conf
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/*/lib/ocaml/Makefile.config
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/*/lib/ocaml/runtime-launch-info
        ignore:
          # --- NATIVE/CROSS-TARGET: Standard bytecode files ---
          - if: is_standard_layout
            then:
              - bin/ocam{l,lcmt,lcp,ldebug,ldoc,lmklib,lmktop,loptp,lprof}
              - lib/ocaml/**/*.{cmo,cma,cmi,cmx,cmt,cmti}
              - bin/ocaml{c,dep,lex,objinfo,opt}.byte

          # --- CROSS-COMPILER: Cross-compiler bytecode files ---
          - if: is_cross_compiler
            then:
              - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/*/lib/ocaml/**/*.{cmo,cma,cmi,cmx,cmt,cmti}
              - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/*/bin/ocam{l,lcmt,lcp,ldebug,ldoc,lmklib,lmktop,loptp,lprof}
              - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/*/bin/ocaml{c,dep,lex,objinfo,opt}.byte

    # ========================================================================
    # REQUIREMENTS
    # ========================================================================
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        strong:
          # gcc-built exes import api-ms-win-crt-* (UCRT); the m2w64 sysroot
          # only exports libwinpthread
          - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
            then:
              - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
              - ucrt >=10.0.20348.0
          # the vs runtime packages, without the vs activation package that
          # stdlib("c") would pull into every downstream host env
          - if: not unix and c_compiler == "vs2022"
            then:
              - vc >=14.3,<15
              - vc14_runtime >=14.44.35208
              - ucrt >=10.0.20348.0
        strong_constraints:
          - if: not unix
            then:
              - ocaml_${{ cross_target_platform_ }} * ${{ cc }}_*
      build:
        # --- Common build deps (all cases) ---
        - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ m2 }}bash >=5.2
        - ${{ m2 }}file
        - ${{ m2 }}findutils
        - ${{ m2 }}gawk
        - ${{ m2 }}grep
        - ${{ m2 }}make
        - ${{ m2 }}sed
        - ${{ m2 }}tar
        # no win-arm64 build exists; that lane is bytecode-only and needs no native binutils
        - if: build_platform != "win-arm64"
          then: binutils
        - if: cross_target_platform_ == "win-arm64"
          then:
            - zig_win-arm64 0.17.*

        # --- CROSS-COMPILER: Target platform toolchain ---
        # Guard (cross_target_platform_ != build_platform) prevents self-referenced cycle detection
        - if: is_cross_compiler and (linux or osx) and (cross_target_platform_ != build_platform)
          then:
            - if: build_number == 0
              then:
                - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} >=5.4
              else:
                - ocaml_${{ build_platform }}[version="${{ version }}.*", build_number=">=${{ build_number - 1 }}"]
            - if: linux
              then:
                - ${{ cc }}_impl_${{ cross_target_platform_ }} ${{ cross_c_compiler_version }}*
                - sysroot_${{ cross_target_platform_ }} ${{ cross_stdlib_version }}.*
                - binutils_impl_${{ cross_target_platform_ }}
                # crossopt emulates target binaries on the build machine; empty
                # on lanes where is_qemuable is false, so inert there.
                - if: is_qemuable
                  then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}
              else:
                - ${{ cc }}_impl_${{ cross_target_platform_ }} ${{ cross_c_compiler_version }}*

        # --- CROSS-TARGET: Bootstrap compiler for cross-compilation ---
        - if: is_cross_target
          then:
            - if: has_zstd
              then: zstd
            # run-target.sh emulates target binaries during crossopt
            - if: is_qemuable
              then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}
            - if: build_number == 0
              then:
                - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} >=5.4
                - if: not bootstrap_in_lane
                  then:
                    - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} >=5.4
              else:
                - ocaml_${{ build_platform }}[version="${{ version }}.*", build_number=">=${{ build_number - 1 }}"]
                - if: not bootstrap_in_lane
                  then:
                    - ocaml_${{ target_platform }}[version="${{ version }}.*", build_number=">=${{ build_number - 1 }}"]

        # --- non-unix-specific ---
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ${{ m2 }}coreutils
            - ${{ m2 }}diffutils
            - ${{ m2 }}which

        # --- OSX-specific ---
        - if: osx
          then:
            - lld ${{ c_compiler_version }}*
            - llvm-tools ${{ c_compiler_version }}*

      # A cross-compiler runs on its build platform, which has zstd: even for
      # a zstd-free target its compilers link libzstd to read compressed .cmi.
      host:
        - if: has_zstd or is_cross_compiler
          then: zstd

      run:
        - if: has_zstd or is_cross_compiler
          then: zstd
        # OCaml needs a C compiler at runtime - ocamlopt, conda-ocaml-mkexe,
        # conda-ocaml-mkdll all invoke the C compiler. Must use the activating
        # metapackages (not _impl) because _impl doesn't put tools in PATH.
        - if: is_standard_layout
          then:
            # Open floors, not compiler()'s exact major, so an env with a newer
            # compiler can still take this build.
            - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
              then:
                # The floor matches the libgcc major (15) this build links against
                - gcc_${{ target_platform }} >=${{ m2w64_c_compiler_version }}
              else:
                # The s390x toolchain stops at gcc 14 and must co-install with
                # this package.
                - if: linux
                  then:
                    - ${{ cc }}_${{ target_platform }} >=14
                - if: osx
                  then:
                    - ${{ cc }}_${{ target_platform }} >=${{ c_compiler_version }}
                # zig has no c_compiler_version variant; the floor matches the
                # zig the build pins.
                - if: not unix and c_compiler == "zig"
                  then:
                    - zig_${{ target_platform }} >=0.17
            - if: osx
              then:
                - lld >=${{ c_compiler_version }}
                - llvm-tools >=${{ c_compiler_version }}

        # --- CROSS-COMPILER ONLY: target C toolchain ---
        # No native OCaml run dep: the cross tree ships its own BUILD-arch
        # ocamlrun for its bytecode tools. A downstream build that also needs the
        # native compiler (dune, findlib) requests ocaml_<build_platform> itself.
        - if: is_cross_compiler and (linux or osx)
          then:
            - if: linux
              then:
                - gcc_impl_${{ cross_target_platform_ }} >=${{ cross_c_compiler_version }}
                - binutils_impl_${{ cross_target_platform_ }}
              else:
                - clang_impl_${{ cross_target_platform_ }} >=${{ cross_c_compiler_version }}
                - lld >=${{ c_compiler_version }}
                - llvm-tools >=${{ c_compiler_version }}

      run_constraints:
        - if: osx
          then:
            - lld >=${{ c_compiler_version }}
        # The vs2022 activation runs vcvars. As a run dep it lands in every env
        # holding ocaml (build and host) and runs twice, overflowing cmd.exe,
        # so consumers bring compiler("c") themselves.
        - if: is_standard_layout and not unix and c_compiler == "vs2022"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}

    # ========================================================================
    # TESTS
    # ========================================================================
    tests:
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Package contents verification
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          bin:
            # NATIVE and CROSS-TARGET: native toolset for the target platform
            - if: is_standard_layout
              then:
                - conda-ocaml-ar
                - conda-ocaml-as
                - conda-ocaml-cc
                - conda-ocaml-ld
                - conda-ocaml-ranlib
                - if: unix
                  then:
                    - conda-ocaml-common.sourced
                    - conda-ocaml-mkdll
                    - conda-ocaml-mkexe
                - ocaml
                - ocamlc
                - ocamldep
                - ocamllex
                - ocamlobjinfo
                - ocamlmklib
                - ocamlyacc
                - ocamlc.byte
                - ocamldep.byte
                - ocamllex.byte
                - ocamlobjinfo.byte
                - ocamlcmt
                - ocamlcp
                - ocamlmktop
                - ocamlprof
                - ocamlrun
                - ocamlrund
                - if: has_native_backend
                  then:
                    - ocamlopt
                    - ocamlc.opt
                    - ocamldep.opt
                    - ocamllex.opt
                    - ocamlobjinfo.opt
                    - ocamlopt.opt
                    - ocamlopt.byte
                    - ocamloptp
                - if: unix or c_compiler in ["vs2022", "zig"]
                  then:
                    - ocamlruni
                - if: not unix and c_compiler == "vs2022"
                  then:
                    - default_amd64.manifest
                - if: not unix
                  then:
                    - flexlink
                    - flexlink.byte
                    - if: has_native_backend
                      then:
                        - flexlink.opt
                    - conda-ocaml-windres

            # NATIVE only: not built when cross-compiling
            - if: is_native
              then:
                - ocamldebug
            - if: is_native and has_ocamldoc
              then:
                - ocamldoc
                - ocamldoc.opt

            # CROSS-COMPILER: Prefixed cross tools
            - if: is_cross_compiler
              then:
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlc
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamldep
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamllex
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlobjinfo
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlopt
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlmklib
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlyacc
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlc.opt
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamldep.opt
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamllex.opt
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlobjinfo.opt
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlopt.opt
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlmklib.opt
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocamlyacc.opt
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocaml-ar
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocaml-as
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocaml-cc
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocaml-ld
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocaml-mkdll
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocaml-mkexe
                - ${{ target_triplet }}-ocaml-ranlib

          files:
            - etc/conda/test-files/*

            # NATIVE/CROSS-TARGET: Standard layout
            - if: is_standard_layout
              then:
                - etc/conda/activate.d/ocaml_activate.${{ sh }}
                - etc/conda/deactivate.d/ocaml_deactivate.${{ sh }}
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/expunge${{ xt }}
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/ld.conf
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/Makefile.config
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/runtime-launch-info
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/sys.ml.in
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/*.{a,cma,cmi,cmo,cmt,cmti,cmx,cmxa,ml,mli,o}
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/caml/domain_state.tbl
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/caml/*.h
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/compiler-libs/*
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/dynlink/*
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/profiling/*
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/runtime_events/*
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/stdlib/*
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/str/*
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/threads/*
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/unix/*
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/stublibs/dll*.${{ so }}
                - ${{ library }}share/doc/ocaml/*
                - if: unix
                  then:
                    - ${{ library }}share/man/man1/*
                - if: is_native and has_ocamldoc
                  then:
                    - ${{ library }}share/man/man3/*
                - if: unix or c_compiler == "gcc"
                  then:
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libasmrun.a
                  else:
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcamlrun.lib
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcamlrund.lib
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcamlruni.lib
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcamlruntime_eventsbyt.lib
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcamlstrbyt.lib
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libthreads.lib
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libunixbyt.lib
                    - if: has_native_backend
                      then:
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libasmrun.lib
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libasmrund.lib
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libasmruni.lib
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcamlruntime_eventsnat.lib
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcamlstrnat.lib
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcomprmarsh.lib
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libthreadsnat.lib
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libunixnat.lib
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/std_exit.obj
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/stdlib.lib
                    # flexdll ships a different initer object per toolchain.
                    - if: c_compiler == "vs2022"
                      then:
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/flexdll/flexdll_initer_msvc64.obj
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/flexdll/flexdll_msvc64.obj
                    - if: c_compiler == "zig"
                      then:
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/flexdll/flexdll_initer_mingw64arm.obj
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/flexdll/flexdll_mingw64arm.obj
                        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/flexdll/lib*.a
                - if: unix
                  then:
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libasmrun_shared.so
                    - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/libcamlrun_shared.so

            # NATIVE: Also includes ocamldoc directory
            - if: is_native and has_ocamldoc
              then:
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/ocamldoc/*

            # CROSS-COMPILER: Cross-compiler layout
            - if: is_cross_compiler
              then:
                - etc/conda/activate.d/ocaml_cross_activate.sh
                - etc/conda/deactivate.d/ocaml_cross_deactivate.sh
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlc
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamldep
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamllex
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlobjinfo
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlopt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlmklib
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlyacc
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlc.opt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamldep.opt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamllex.opt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlobjinfo.opt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlopt.opt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocamlrun
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/bin/ocaml
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocamlc
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocamlc.opt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocamldep
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocamldep.opt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocamlmklib
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocamlobjinfo
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocamlopt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocamlopt.opt
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/shims/ocaml
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/expunge${{ xt }}
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/ld.conf
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/libasmrun.a
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/libasmrun_shared.so
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/libcamlrun_shared.so
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/Makefile.config
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/runtime-launch-info
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/sys.ml.in
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/*.{a,cma,cmi,cmo,cmt,cmti,cmx,cmxa,ml,mli,o}
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/caml/domain_state.tbl
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/caml/*.h
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/compiler-libs/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/dynlink/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/profiling/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/runtime_events/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/stdlib/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/str/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/threads/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/unix/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/lib/ocaml/stublibs/dll*.${{ so }}
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/share/doc/ocaml/*
                - lib/ocaml-cross-compilers/${{ target_triplet }}/share/man/man1/*

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Package integrity: paths, config, env vars, rpath
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          - if: is_qemuable
            then: |
              export OCAML_QEMU=qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }}
          - if: is_native
            then: cd testing && ${{ dot }}test-package-integrity.${{ sh }}
          - if: is_cross_target
            then: cd testing && ./test-package-integrity.sh cross-target
          - if: is_cross_compiler
            then: cd testing && ./test-package-integrity.sh cross ${{ target_triplet }}
          - if: not (is_native or is_cross_target or is_cross_compiler)
            then: echo "Invalid artifact" && exit 1
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-package-integrity.${{ sh }}
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ m2 }}grep
            # Native readelf/strings for inspecting target binaries
            - if: unix
              then:
                - binutils_impl_${{ build_platform }}
            - if: is_qemuable
              then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # CROSS-TARGET: Cross-compiled binary architecture verification
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          - if: is_cross_target
            then: cd testing && ${{ dot }}test-cross-arch.sh ${{ target_platform }}
            else: echo "Native build or cross-compiler - skipping cross-arch check"
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-cross-arch.sh
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ m2 }}grep
            - if: unix
              then:
                - binutils_impl_${{ build_platform }}

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # NATIVE: Tool version checks
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          - if: is_native
            then: cd testing && ${{ dot }}test-tool-versions.${{ sh }} ${{ version }} ${{ native_mode }}
            else: echo "Skipping tool version tests"
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-tool-versions.${{ sh }}
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ m2 }}grep

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # NATIVE: Native-only tools test (ocamldoc, ocamldebug)
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          - if: is_native and unix
            then: cd testing && ${{ dot }}test-native-only-tools.sh ${{ version }}
            else: echo "Skipping native-only tools"
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-native-only-tools.sh
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ m2 }}grep

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Compiler wrapper validation (conda-ocaml-cc, conda-ocaml-mkexe)
      # NO extra C compiler test dep - validates that ocaml_$platform's run dep
      # on compiler("c") provides the triplet-prefixed binary.
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          # Target binaries need user-mode emulation when the host arch differs
          - if: is_qemuable
            then: |
              export OCAML_QEMU=qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }}
          - if: is_native and unix
            then: cd testing && ./test-compiler-wrappers.sh
          - if: is_cross_target
            then: cd testing && ./test-compiler-wrappers.sh cross-target
          - if: not (is_native and unix) and not is_cross_target
            then: echo "Skipping wrapper tests"
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-compiler-wrappers.sh
        requirements:
          build:
            - if: is_qemuable
              then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # CROSS-COMPILER: Activation script tests (ocaml_use_cross/ocaml_use_native)
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          - if: is_cross_compiler
            then: cd testing && ./test-cross-activation.sh
            else: echo "Skipping cross-activation tests"
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-cross-activation.sh

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # CROSS-COMPILER: self-activation in a cross-compiling env puts the
      # bare-name cross tools first on PATH
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          - if: is_cross_compiler
            then: cd testing && ./test-cross-self-activation.sh ${{ target_triplet }}
            else: echo "Skipping cross self-activation tests"
        files:
          recipe:
            - if: is_cross_compiler
              then:
                - testing/test-cross-self-activation.sh
        requirements:
          build:
            - if: is_cross_compiler
              then:
                - file

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # CROSS-COMPILER: Functional tests
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          # Emulator for running target binaries on the build platform
          - if: is_qemuable
            then: |
              export OCAML_QEMU=qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }}
          - if: is_cross_compiler
            then: |
              cd testing
              ./test-cross-compilers.sh ${{ version }} ${{ build_platform }} ${{ target_platform }} ${{ target_triplet }}
            else: echo "Not a cross-compiler package"
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-cross-compilers.sh
        requirements:
          build:
            - if: is_qemuable
              then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}
            - ${{ m2 }}file

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # CROSS-COMPILER: .cmi interop with the native compiler, the one check
      # that needs ocaml_<build_platform>, which is not a run dep
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          - if: is_cross_compiler
            then: |
              cd testing
              ./test-cross-compilers.sh ${{ version }} ${{ build_platform }} ${{ target_platform }} ${{ target_triplet }} native-interop
            else: echo "Not a cross-compiler package"
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-cross-compilers.sh
        requirements:
          run:
            - if: is_cross_compiler
              then:
                - ocaml_${{ build_platform }}[version="${{ version }}.*", build_number=">=${{ build_number - 1 }}"]

  # ==========================================================================
  # TOOLCHAIN META-PACKAGE: ocaml-compiler
  # Convenience package: OCaml + binutils (ar, nm, objdump for debugging)
  # C compiler and linker are already run deps of ocaml_$platform
  # ==========================================================================
  - package:
      name: ocaml-compiler
    build:
      string: ${{ cc ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      skip: cross_target_platform_ != target_platform
      script: echo "Toolchain meta-package"
      # Down-prioritize the vs2022 track so the solver prefers gcc on win-64
      variant:
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if is_vs2022 else 0 }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('ocaml', exact=True) }}
        - if: unix or c_compiler == "gcc"
          then:
            - binutils_impl_${{ target_platform }}
    tests:
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Package contents (metapackage - only test files)
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          files:
            - etc/conda/test-files/ocaml-compiler/*/testing/*

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Basic toolchain verification
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          - if: is_qemuable
            then: |
              export OCAML_QEMU=qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }}
              command -v "${OCAML_QEMU}" >/dev/null || { echo "[FAIL] ${OCAML_QEMU} not found on PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
              qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }} "$(command -v ocamlopt${{ xt }})" -version && echo "ocaml-compiler toolchain ready"
          - if: not is_qemuable and has_native_backend
            then: ocamlopt${{ xt }} -version && echo "ocaml-compiler toolchain ready"
          - if: not is_qemuable and not has_native_backend
            then: ocamlc${{ xt }} -version && echo "ocaml-compiler toolchain ready"
        requirements:
          build:
            - if: is_qemuable
              then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Compilation tests (requires C toolchain)
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          # Target binaries need user-mode emulation when the host arch differs
          - if: is_qemuable
            then: |
              export OCAML_QEMU=qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }}
          - cd testing && ${{ dot }}test-compilation.${{ sh }} ${{ version }} ${{ native_mode }}
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-compilation.${{ sh }}
            - if: unix
              then:
                - testing/test-helpers.sh
            - if: not unix
              then:
                - testing/run-with-timeout.ps1
                - testing/load-dll.ps1
                - testing/pe_reloc_check.ml
        requirements:
          build:
            - if: is_qemuable
              then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}
            - ${{ m2 }}file
            - ${{ m2 }}grep
            - if: not unix and c_compiler == "vs2022"
              then: ${{ compiler("c") }}

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # compiler-libs native link (issue #132)
      # unix only - no .bat companion
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          # Target binaries need user-mode emulation when the host arch differs
          - if: is_qemuable
            then: |
              export OCAML_QEMU=qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }}
              command -v "${OCAML_QEMU}" >/dev/null || { echo "[FAIL] ${OCAML_QEMU} not found on PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
          - if: unix
            then: cd testing && ./test-compiler-libs-link.sh ${{ version }}
            else: echo "Skipping compiler-libs link test (needs unix)"
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-compiler-libs-link.sh
            - testing/test-helpers.sh
        requirements:
          build:
            - if: is_qemuable
              then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # CONDA_OCAML_* toolchain variable tests
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - script:
          # Target binaries need user-mode emulation when the host arch differs
          - if: is_qemuable
            then: |
              export OCAML_QEMU=qemu-execve-${{ qemu_arch }}
          - cd testing && ${{ dot }}test-toolchain-vars.${{ sh }} ${{ native_mode }}
        files:
          recipe:
            - testing/test-toolchain-vars.${{ sh }}
            - if: unix
              then:
                - testing/test-helpers.sh
        requirements:
          build:
            - if: is_qemuable
              then: ${{ qemu_pkg }}
            - ${{ m2 }}grep
            - if: not unix and c_compiler == "vs2022"
              then: ${{ compiler("c") }}

about:
  homepage: https://ocaml.org/
  license: LGPL-2.1-only WITH OCaml-LGPL-linking-exception
  license_family: LGPL
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Objective Caml (OCaml) is an implementation of the ML language.
  description: |
    OCaml is an implementation of the ML language, based on the Caml Light
    dialect extended with a complete class-based object system and a powerful
    module system in the style of Standard ML.

    OCaml comprises two compilers. One generates bytecode which is then
    interpreted by a C program. This compiler runs quickly, generates compact
    code with moderate memory requirements, and is portable to essentially any
    32 or 64 bit Unix platform. Performance of generated programs is quite good
    for a bytecoded implementation.  This compiler can be used either as a
    standalone, batch-oriented compiler that produces standalone programs, or as
    an interactive, toplevel-based system.

    The other compiler generates high-performance native code for a number of
    processors. Compilation takes longer and generates bigger code, but the
    generated programs deliver excellent performance, while retaining the
    moderate memory requirements of the bytecode compiler.
  documentation: https://ocaml.org/docs/
  repository: https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - isuruf
    - dslarm
    - MementoRC
